ctx.x: Well, when I first went to Boston, I think it went this way. I was studying at the same time and got in Boston a gig at a place called the Little Dixie. And there was a band I

there by the name of Dean Earl and his -- I forget what they called it. Dean Earl had the band at the time. And in the band was a trumpet player by name of Jabbo Jenkins, and drummer, I forget what his name was. But also I remember the saxophonist, alto saxophone player doubled on a little violin. His name was Ray Perry.
